architecture.deploymentShape: three-target acyclic graph: initializer, token, hook
architecture.initializer: one-shot atomic pool initialization, full-range LP mint, and initial buy
architecture.token: fixed-supply ERC-20 with no owner, mint, pause, blacklist, upgrade, transfer fee, or rescue path
architecture.hook: canonical-pool dynamic LP-fee override with immutable configuration

poolKey.hooks: deployed hook address with BEFORE_INITIALIZE and BEFORE_SWAP flags

feeSchedule.scope: canonical ETH/V4 Uniswap v4 pool only
feeSchedule.windowStart: first successful canonical swap, which must be the initializer's atomic initial buy
feeSchedule.swapCoverage: both directions and both exact-input and exact-output modes in the canonical pool
feeSchedule.accounting: Uniswap v4 LP fee; accrues to active liquidity providers according to liquidity share, subject to protocol accounting

initialLiquidity.priceNote: USD values are planning references, not an onchain oracle guarantee. Exact ETH amount and Q64.96 price must be computed from a fresh launch-time quote.
initialLiquidity.futureLiquidity: permissionless; each later position remains controlled by its own NFT owner

initialBuy.note: The initial buy is part of the atomic launch and is charged the 30% launch LP fee. Exact input and slippage bounds remain launch-time inputs.

distribution.migrationExecution: separate later owner-controlled operation after launch and LP verification

launchTimeRequiredInputs: fresh chain trust-root addresses, linkage, runtime code hashes, and block binding
immutable source revision and official platform-generated bundle
fresh ETH/USD quote source and timestamp
LP native budget in wei and exact previewed principals
initial-buy native amount, minimum token output, price limit, and deadline
fresh expected runtime code hashes for initializer, token, and hook
launch-wallet signature and explicit funding approval
